title: 第一卷 第19章 无面人表演第一卷 第20章 入了青帮便没有回头路了
lines: 陈玄昨天走过一次之后，他轻车熟路的就来到了玄天阁！
刚刚走入，林掌柜就热情的迎了过来道：“哟呵，小哥儿？怎么样？那神龙九变修炼一天提升如何？”
陈玄苦笑了一声道：“林掌柜，我昨天给主子办了点儿事儿，得了功法奖励，但是我想要修炼，却发现周遭灵气根本就无法进入身体，我不知道是不是这神龙九变的原因！”
林掌柜神色一动道：“你在修炼新得到的功法之前，修炼过神龙九变吗？”
陈玄点头道：“只修炼了片刻而已！”
“那就没办法了！”林掌柜道：“这神龙九变，只要修炼了，哪怕只是片刻，也再也无法修炼其他的功法！”
得到了林掌柜的确认，陈玄心里骂了一句，他苦笑了一声道：“行吧！”
他从玄天阁出来，整理了一下自己的情绪！
他很蛋疼。
神龙九变品级不详，修炼起来难度极大，而且烈阳决因为不能外传，相当于是浪费了。
这可是玄阶高级功法，价值难以估量。
“罢了，神龙九变就神龙九变吧！”陈玄默默的摇了摇头道：“多耗费一些时间和银钱就是了。”
说着，他默默的朝着菜市的方向赶了过去。
他今日出来，除开买菜之外，还打算去找一下他哥哥陈岩！
他要开设酒肆，他肯定自己没办法去当厨子，一天下来都会很忙，他根本就没时间去练武了！
而要论最信任的人，在这个世界，他的哥哥陈岩，是毫无疑问的。
虽然陈玄不知道他当无面人到底是做什么，但是他估摸着，只要酒肆开启之后，能够赚取的银钱，肯定不是他去当无面人能够比拟的。
陈玄走了一段时间，他就看到了前方，一个清秀的女子正背着孩子，奋力的推着一个板车在前行着，在板车上，还有着两个孩子，乖巧的坐在上面。
赫然是被青帮堂主看到的那个穆念。
此时的她眼眶通红，一边推着板车，一边在流着泪。
陈玄站在路边看着，忽然之间，他看到了不远处，有着一个脸上有着一个刀客打扮的人，正站在一个路边的摊位上询问着什么？
陈玄心中一动道：“这个人…好像看到好几次了！”
前世作为特种兵的他，有着极强的反侦察能力，他隐隐感觉到了一丝的不对劲，不过此时的他，却没有表现出来。
与此同时，穆念也推着车，路过了他的身边。
她车上的菜，看起来依然是非常的新鲜。
“不卖菜了？”陈玄问道。
穆念听到这话，她下意识朝着陈玄看了过来，在看到陈玄之后，她明显的愣了一下。
然后她用手擦了擦脸上的眼泪，苦笑道：“是你啊，小弟弟！”
陈玄无奈，也是，他这副身子，也就十六岁而已，这穆念称呼自己为小弟弟，倒也没问题。
说着，她努力对着陈玄挤出了一丝的笑容道：“青帮的人一直守在那里，没人敢买我的菜，你也少与我搭话吧，我是个不详的女人，会给你招来麻烦的！”
“你这菜是自家种的？”陈玄问道。

After Chen Xuan walked through it once yesterday, he arrived at Xuantian Pavilion with ease!
As soon as he walked in, shopkeeper Lin greeted him enthusiastically and said, "Hey, little brother? How are you? How about improving after practicing the Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon for a day?"
Chen Xuan smiled bitterly and said: "Shopkeeper Lin, I did something for the master yesterday and got a skill reward. However, when I wanted to practice, I found that the surrounding spiritual energy could not enter the body at all. I don't know if it is the reason for the nine transformations of the dragon!"
Shopkeeper Lin's expression changed and he said, "Have you practiced the Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon before practicing the newly acquired skills?"
Chen Xuan nodded and said: "I only practiced for a moment!"
"Then there's nothing we can do!" Shopkeeper Lin said: "Once you practice this Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon, even for just a moment, you will never be able to practice other techniques again!"
After receiving the confirmation from Shopkeeper Lin, Chen Xuan cursed in his heart, smiled bitterly and said, "Okay!"
He came out of Xuantian Pavilion and sorted out his emotions!
He's a pain in the ass.
The level of the Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon is unknown, and it is extremely difficult to practice. Moreover, since the Lieyang Jue cannot be passed on to others, it is equivalent to a waste.
This is an advanced Xuan-level technique and its value is immeasurable.
"That's all, let's just go with the Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon!" Chen Xuan shook his head silently and said, "Just spend more time and money."
With that said, he silently hurried towards the vegetable market.
When he came out today, in addition to buying groceries, he also planned to go find his brother Chen Yan!
He wants to open a restaurant, and he is sure that he will not be able to work as a cook. He will be very busy at the end of the day, and he will have no time to practice martial arts!
As for the person he trusts the most, there is no doubt that his brother Chen Yan is the one in this world.
Although Chen Xuan didn't know what he was doing as a Faceless Man, he estimated that as long as the wine shop opened, the money he could earn would definitely not be comparable to what he could do as a Faceless Man.
After Chen Xuan walked for a while, he saw in front of him a delicate woman carrying a child on her back, struggling to push a cart forward. On the cart, there were two children, sitting obediently on it.
It was the Mu Nian who was seen by the leader of the Qing Gang.
At this time, her eyes were red, and she was crying while pushing the cart.
Chen Xuan stood on the roadside and watched. Suddenly, he saw a man with a swordsman's face not far away, standing at a roadside stall asking what?
Chen Xuan was moved in his heart and said: "This person... seems to have been seen several times!"
As a special soldier in his previous life, he had extremely strong anti-reconnaissance capabilities. He vaguely felt something was wrong, but at this time, he did not show it.
At the same time, Mu Nian pushed a cart and passed by him.
The food on her cart still looks very fresh.
"No more vegetables?" Chen Xuan asked.
When Mu Nian heard this, she subconsciously looked towards Chen Xuan. After seeing Chen Xuan, she was obviously stunned for a moment.
Then she wiped the tears on her face with her hand and said with a wry smile: "It's you, little brother!"
"Uh!"
Chen Xuan was helpless. With his body, he was only sixteen years old. It was okay for Mu Nian to call him his little brother.
As she said that, she tried her best to smile at Chen Xuan and said: "The people from the Qing Gang have been guarding there. No one dares to buy my food. You should stop talking to me. I am an unknown woman and will cause you trouble!"
"Did you grow this vegetable at home?" Chen Xuan asked.
